text.hr: Kupio sam onu rižu koju voliš. Dolaziš?
text.en: I bought that rice you like. Are you coming over?

text.hr: Radiš svaku večer već tri tjedna.
text.en: You have been working every night for three weeks.
I know. Give me a week.

text.hr: Imaju popis. Ja sam na njemu. Ti još nisi.
text.en: They have a list. I am on it. You are not, yet.

text.hr: Ne preko poruke. Dođi u petak.
text.en: Not over text. Come on Friday.

text.hr: Ako se ne javim do nedjelje, ne traži me. Traži papire.
text.en: If I do not write by Sunday, do not look for me. Look for the paperwork.

text.hr: Danas sam napokon dobila popis. Trinaest dana prekasno.
text.en: I finally got the list today. Thirteen days too late.

text.hr: Ne s ovog broja više. Kupite drugi.
text.en: Not from this number any more. Buy another one.

text.hr: Treba mi popis potpisnika. Samo imena.
text.en: I need the list of signatories. Names only.
Do you know what you are asking for?

text.hr: Sutra u devet. Ne dolazite autom.
text.en: Nine tomorrow. Do not come by car.

secondary.en: seven messages, all about the deadline

text.hr: Imam drugi izvor. Treba mi još tjedan.
text.en: I have a second source. I need another week.

text.hr: Ako ti se ne javim do jutra, nazovi Ivanu.
text.en: If you do not hear from me by morning, ring Ivana.

note.hr:
Ne zovi prije deset. Ne piše prije kave.

Ako se ne javi iz prve, javit će se iz druge.
note.en:
Do not call before ten. He does not write before coffee.

If he does not pick up first time, he picks up the second.

note.hr: Nedjeljom u jedan. Uvijek nedjeljom u jedan. Zadnji zapis uz kontakt: „ne govori joj o poslu“.
note.en: Sundays at one. Always Sundays at one. The last line saved with the contact: "do not tell her about work".

note.hr: Ako mi se išta dogodi — ona prva, pa tek onda redakcija. Napisano u polju za bilješku, kao da je adresa.
note.en: If anything happens to me — her first, the newsroom second. Written in the notes field, as if it were an address.

note.hr: Zove samo zbog roka. Ako zove dvaput zaredom, onda nije zbog roka.
note.en: She only calls about the deadline. If she calls twice running, it is not about the deadline.

note.hr: Utorkom u 18:00. Jedini termin u kalendaru koji se ponavlja i jedini koji nikad nije otkazan.
note.en: Tuesdays at 18:00. The only recurring appointment in the calendar, and the only one never cancelled.

note.hr: Spremljen bez imena, a spremljen je. Jedini kontakt u imeniku koji nema ime. Netko koga je htjela moći nazvati, a ne htjela da itko vidi koga zove.
note.en: Saved with no name — but saved. The only contact in the phonebook without a name. Somebody she wanted to be able to ring, and did not want anybody to see her ringing.

note.hr: Zvali su tri puta u tjedan dana, uvijek s istog broja, uvijek u uredovno vrijeme. Prve tri znamenke iste su kao kod kontakta bez imena. Ista centrala, druga osoba.
note.en: They rang three times in a week, always from the same number, always in office hours. The first digits match the contact with no name. Same switchboard, different person.

body.hr: Noćni vozni red. Zadnji tramvaj s njezine strane grada polazi u 00:12. Preuzela ga je u 23:41. Trideset i jednu minutu prije polaska.
body.en: The night timetable. The last tram from her side of the city leaves at 00:12. She downloaded it at 23:41. Thirty-one minutes before it left.

body.hr: Zahtjev za pristup arhivskoj građi. Sva polja prazna osim jednog. U rubrici „svrha“ piše: novinarska obrada. Nikad ga nije predala. Vjerojatno zato što bi ga netko morao odobriti.
body.en: A request for access to archived records. Every field blank but one. Under "purpose" it says: journalistic work. She never filed it. Probably because somebody would have had to approve it.

body.hr: Potpis, uvećan dok se ne vide zrna papira. Isti potpis pojavljuje se na tri različita dokumenta iz tri različita mjeseca.
body.en: A signature, enlarged until the grain of the paper shows. The same signature appears on three different documents from three different months.

body.hr: Stranica 14 protokola. Popis suautora, i jedno ime podvučeno dvaput. Podvukla ga je ona, ne skener.
body.en: Page 14 of the protocol. The list of co-authors, with one name underlined twice. She underlined it, not the scanner.

body.hr: Dvije kave. Plaćeno gotovinom u 20:48, dvanaest minuta prije termina bez naslova. Dvije kave znače da nije čekala sama.
body.en: Two coffees. Paid in cash at 20:48, twelve minutes before the untitled appointment. Two coffees mean she was not waiting alone.

body.hr: Sedam datoteka obrisano je u istih dvadeset i sedam minuta. Nijedna nije iz radne mape. Sve su fotografije, i sve su s istog rođendana. Brisala je uspomene, a ostavila dokaze. Netko tko je mislio da će netko drugi ovo gledati.
body.en: Seven files were deleted inside the same twenty-seven minutes. Not one of them is from the working folder. They are all photographs, and all from the same birthday. She deleted the memories and left the evidence. Somebody who expected another person to go through this.

body.hr: NACRT — v3 Trinaest ljudi umrlo je u ispitivanju lijeka koje je službeno prekinuto zbog „slabog odaziva“. Devet od trinaest smrti naknadno je prekvalificirano u „nepovezane s ispitivanjem“. Sve devet potpisala je ista osoba, i to nakon što je podstudija zaustavljena. Ispod, u zagradi: „ovo je treća verzija uvoda. Prva je bila točnija. Vidi nacrt_v1.“
body.en: DRAFT — v3 Thirteen people died in a drug trial that was officially halted for "poor recruitment". Nine of the thirteen deaths were later reclassified as "unrelated to the trial". All nine were signed off by the same person, and signed after the substudy was stopped. Below, in brackets: "this is the third version of the intro. The first was more accurate. See draft_v1."

body.hr: NACRT — v1 Šimunić je potpisao devet smrtovnica za ispitivanje u kojem je i sam bio suautor protokola. Nitko ga nije pitao kako je to moguće, jer nitko izvan te zgrade nije znao da su te dvije stvari ista osoba. Preko cijelog odlomka, žutim: „ovo ne prolazi pravnu. Ali je istina.“
body.en: DRAFT — v1 Šimunić signed nine death certificates for a trial whose protocol he had co-authored. Nobody asked him how that was possible, because nobody outside that building knew those two things were the same person. Across the whole paragraph, in yellow: "this will not clear legal. But it is true."

body.hr: inicijali,dob,datum,prvi nalaz,preklasificirano M.K.,61,2016-04-02,da,da J.B.,58,2016-05-19,da,da A.P.,44,2016-06-07,da,ne S.T.,72,2016-06-30,da,da V.M.,55,2016-08-11,da,da … Trinaest redaka. Devet ih u zadnjem stupcu ima „da“. Treći red nije prekvalificiran. Treći red ima iste inicijale kao žena s fotografije.
body.en: initials,age,date,first finding,reclassified M.K.,61,2016-04-02,yes,yes J.B.,58,2016-05-19,yes,yes A.P.,44,2016-06-07,yes,no S.T.,72,2016-06-30,yes,yes V.M.,55,2016-08-11,yes,yes … Thirteen rows. Nine of them say "yes" in the last column. The third row was not reclassified. The third row has the same initials as the woman in the photograph.

body.hr: # Kronologija **14.03.2016.** — prvi dan podstudije. (Ana ima fotografiju s tog dana.) **06.2016.** — A.P. umire. Jedina smrt koja NIJE prekvalificirana. **11.2016.** — podstudija zaustavljena, službeno zbog odaziva. **12.2016.** — devet prekvalifikacija, sve u tri tjedna, sve isti potpis. **03.2019.** — Ana P. (druga Ana, novinarka) dobiva popis. Umire prije nego ga preda. **ovaj tjedan** — N. pristaje govoriti. Zadnji redak dopisan je drugom bojom.
body.en: # Chronology **14.03.2016** — first day of the substudy. (Ana has a photograph from that day.) **06.2016** — A.P. dies. The only death NOT reclassified. **11.2016** — substudy halted, officially over recruitment. **12.2016** — nine reclassifications, all within three weeks, all the same signature. **03.2019** — Ana P. (the other Ana, the reporter) gets the list. Dies before she can file it. **this week** — N. agrees to talk. The last line was added in a different colour.

body.hr: IZVORI — nikad puna imena u ovoj datoteci N. — arhiva, pristup, jedini koji je pristao ići na zapis. Boji se, i ima pravo. D. — potvrdio protokol, neće se potpisati. M. — odbio. Dvaput. Ž. — poslao mi je jednu rečenicu i obrisao broj. Ispod svega: „ako ovo netko drugi čita, nijedan od njih nije ti dao ovu datoteku.“
body.en: SOURCES — never full names in this file N. — the archive, the access, the only one who agreed to go on record. He is frightened, and he is right to be. D. — confirmed the protocol, will not put his name to it. M. — refused. Twice. Ž. — sent me one sentence and deleted his number. Underneath all of it: "if somebody else is reading this, not one of them gave you this file."

body.hr: PRAVNA PROVJERA — bilješke uz nacrt v2 1. „Ubio ih je“ — ne. Nikada. Ni u jednoj verziji. 2. „Potpisao je devet prekvalifikacija“ — da, ako imate presliku sva tri potpisa. 3. „Zataškavanje“ — ne dok netko to ne kaže na zapis. 4. Ime izvora ne ide u tekst ni pod kojim uvjetima, ni sa suglasnošću. Rukom, na margini, njezinim rukopisom: „4 je jedini savjet koji ću poslušati bez svađe.“
body.en: LEGAL CHECK — notes against draft v2 1. "He killed them" — no. Never. Not in any version. 2. "He signed nine reclassifications" — yes, if you hold copies of all three signatures. 3. "Cover-up" — not until somebody says it on the record. 4. The source's name does not go in the piece under any circumstances, consent or no consent. By hand in the margin, in her writing: "4 is the only advice I will take without arguing."

body.hr: PITANJA — za Š., pisano, s rokom od 48 sati 1. Jeste li bili suautor protokola podstudije? 2. Jeste li potpisali prekvalifikaciju devet smrti u toj istoj podstudiji? 3. Je li itko izvan ustanove o tome obaviješten? 4. Zašto A.P. nije prekvalificirana? Na dnu, sitno: „poslati tek kad N. bude na sigurnom. Ne prije.“
body.en: QUESTIONS — for Š., in writing, 48 hours to respond 1. Were you a co-author of the substudy protocol? 2. Did you sign the reclassification of nine deaths in that same substudy? 3. Was anybody outside the institution informed? 4. Why was A.P. not reclassified? At the bottom, small: "send only once N. is somewhere safe. Not before."

body.hr: Za: (prazno) Predmet: ako ne stignem Vesna, Ako ovo čitaš, tekst nije gotov i ja ti ga ne mogu obraniti. Nemoj ga objaviti dok N. ne kaže da smije. Znam da ćeš htjeti. Nemoj. Sve je u mapi koja izgleda kao da je prazna. Polje „za“ nikad nije ispunila. Zato ni nije mogla poslati.
body.en: To: (empty) Subject: if I do not make it Vesna, If you are reading this, the piece is not finished and I cannot defend it for you. Do not run it until N. says it can run. I know you will want to. Do not. It is all in the folder that looks empty. She never filled in the "to" field. Which is why she could never send it.

body.hr: Što ako griješim. Ako griješim, uništila sam čovjeku život zbog devet potpisa koje je možda potpisao jer mu je netko rekao da potpiše. Ako sam u pravu, a šutim, onda ih je trinaest i nitko za njih nikad neće čuti. Ovo nije hrabrost. Ovo je aritmetika. Datoteka je otvarana četrdeset i jedan put.
body.en: What if I am wrong. If I am wrong, I have destroyed a man over nine signatures he may have signed because somebody told him to sign them. If I am right and I say nothing, then there are thirteen of them and nobody will ever hear about it. This is not courage. This is arithmetic. The file has been opened forty-one times.

body.hr: Termin bez naslova, bez lokacije i bez ijednog gosta. Unesen je istog jutra, u 08:40. U kalendaru koji seže godinu unatrag nema nijednog drugog termina bez naslova.
body.en: An appointment with no title, no location and no guests. Entered the same morning, at 08:40. In a calendar going back a year there is not one other untitled entry.

transcript.hr: …znači ne ide preko njega. Ide preko nekoga tko je to smio potpisati.
transcript.en: …so it does not run through him. It runs through somebody who was allowed to sign it.
Tomorrow I ask for the list —
